about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the foundation module agent-tools becomes the workspace package @purin-labs/agent-tools in foundation/agent-tools. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from versionsFrom. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs, and of a path that is no import; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again. package.typeCheck false: the package has no check:types script of its own. Its own files read no merged Env key, but they import @purin-labs/authority, which imports @purin-labs/tenancy/organisation-execution-scope; that file reads env.ORGANISATION, a key that services/platform/src/actors/organisation.ts (workers/platform) merges with declare module of @purin-labs/kernel/env. The package alone gives 5 errors in that tenancy file. The Worker program checks its files.

edits.why: the IFC import rule of the context files selects services/platform/src/context/**/*.ts; untrusted-commerce-text.ts leaves that folder
the lint of the tool effects reads the tool definitions of the package: messages.ts, files.ts and turn.ts define tools
